coverage.authoredAnalysis: Cover: general elections, 23 July 2023.
Complete index read, including REF/statutory/RUP policy, all social/economic/cultural/external/animal sections and La Palma reconstruction annex.
Complete introduction reread. Plain variant still duplicates the introduction; original has one copy. Rhetoric, statistics and predictions remain attributed claims, never two independent proposals.

Explicit Congress/Senate representation and programme made for Canarias. REF defence links investment/employment and resident air/sea relief. NUL in hijos/hijas visually resolved, cached extraction unchanged.

REF: distinct indirect tax/resources separation; electricity parity, 75% resident air/sea discount and oversight, 100% agricultural/industrial freight aid, tourism/employment/agricultural/water support. Historical tax/legal/aid figures not independently certified.

REF: poverty/broadband/waste/university aid, preserve incentives under minimum-tax harmonisation; audiovisual deduction 80% above State reference, enlarge/remove 55-million aid ceiling, ZEC triangular trade/RIC intangible uses, Canary consent before REF change.
REF evaluation: link incentives more to jobs/diversification/sustainability/digitalisation and consensus measures for crises. No quantified new rate/formula.

Statutory transfers, migration decision participation, asymmetrical federal model/possible constitutional RUP-REF guarantees; airport co-management, reject control-tower privatisation, clean Gran Canaria/Tenerife rail and Africa cooperation.

State budgets: REF separation/programme funds and territorial investment at least regional average. Autonomous finance: increase insularity weighting/no decrease, poverty variable, no exact distribution formula.

RUP/European funds and differential treatment, requested ZEC registration through 2026/benefits through 2032; human rights/climate/safe migration/asylum quotas. Earlier achievements remain source assertions.

RUP: emissions-trading exclusion on Canary-European travel or compensation, fiscal/rail/Africa participation. Education: develop LOMLOE, inclusion, generalise 0-3 education (no free wording), dual vocational training, infrastructure and island travel grants.

Healthcare/care funding/pact/evaluation, school emotional support/crisis/home/psychogeriatric care, older/chronic/loneliness support, dependency funding/plazas and intergenerational living. No exact consultation entitlement.

Climate: territory/primary-sector-compatible wind/solar, offshore socioenvironmental conditions, hydrogen/geothermal/smart-grid research/efficiency; reject gas introduction in Canarias, support pumped storage and decentralised 100% renewable model by 2040. Effects are claims.

Green ports/sustainable aviation fuel. Mobility: walking/cycling/bus/taxi/clean rail, emissions exclusion or compensation, electric fleets, resident 75% air/sea discount and reference maximum fares on public-service-obligation routes, public airport role. Local economy introduction.

Local economy: tourism renewal without extra territory, regulate holiday rentals, industry/AIEM/primary-sector support, reclaimed irrigation water/higher bluefin quotas, culture/audiovisual incentives, science/digital market/circular products. No blanket tourist ban.

Employment background/statistics attributed; wages/stability, dual vocational places, State plan while unemployment above average, REF/targeted active measures/evaluation. Reduced workweek is rigorous debate, no fixed hours/pay mandate.

Youth first jobs/return talent, employer contribution relief for indefinite hires ages 16-30, over 45 and women in underrepresented occupations; green public investment. Pensions: public sustainability/extra revenue, favour lower pensions in nonuniform future rises, gender compensation.

Retirement-age increase discussed critically; remove early-retirement penalties around 40+ contribution years, exact threshold awkward. Administration reform: procurement/procedure/civil-service flexibility without corruption, results evaluation and citizen access.
Administration: evaluated performance pay/practical selection, professional managers, repetitive automation/AI and in-person digital-skills training. Justice backlog background is source assertion.

Justice: Canary staffing/resources powers, more courts/staff functions/pay, renew governing council without election formula, prosecutor autonomy, mediation/family contact/legal aid/peace courts/forensics. Oppose death penalty and Ley mordaza without inferred clause-by-clause stance.

Rights plan/tracking, anti-trafficking/international instruments, gender/child-sexual-crime protection and limitation periods, historical memory, proportional security law; reform border rejection, EU/State asylum and solidary minor distribution/no hot returns/human rights abroad.
Cooperation funding, no percentage here. Security publicly guaranteed/funded/controlled; regional integral police with State finance, no exact staffing/budget figure.

Security transfers: private-security accreditation, volcano consortium, rescue/coastguard/civil protection/traffic. Housing: protected construction/public-private cofinancing, stable aid beyond most vulnerable, landlord incentives and support rent caps especially stressed zones. Original inspected.

Collaborative housing/emergency eviction support, restrict foreign buyers not rooted in islands under State/EU law. Background total 2,808 disagrees with 1,332+1,676; not used as impact evidence. School/green/water/tourism/clean-rail infrastructure.

Protected housing/local role, public airports, road agreement 2018-2027 and 200-million transfer plus interest for temporary nonconsolidated nonfinancial uses. Istanbul/all gender violence, oppose trafficking/prostitution/surrogacy, retain Equality Ministry/regional equivalents/pay-gap action.

Equality: coeducation/affective-sexual teaching, care services for women access, counter homophobia. Culture: dynamic open Canarian identity/heritage/history/traditions and mobility, not user ideology classification.

Canarian culture institutions/dialect official recognition, 40% Canarian curriculum at all levels after community debate, creative freedom/child art, indigenous archaeology/public media. No inference that 40% is language teaching.

Legal safe migration routes/orientation, quality reception/onward transfer, vulnerable minors, Share distribution by unemployment/GDP per person/population; preserve human-rights framework. Background counts attributed.

Demographic figures/projections attributed; moderate sustainable growth, condition tourism in saturated islands and explore temporary population measures negotiated with EU under RUP. No specified migration cap.

Tourism renewal/planning, curb holiday-rental growth in gentrified zones, seek nonresident foreign home-purchase limits. Anti-far-right critique/causal claims are campaign discourse, not neutral quiz statements.

Plural society/democratic freedoms, no political agreements with far-right expressions. External role: peace/cooperation/technology exchange, statutory sea territory and resources background not independently certified geology/legal facts.

Canary people/institutions decide seabed use with environmental/economic criteria; EU/Latin America/Africa relations, UN Western Sahara self-determination referendum, Israel/Palestine two States, humanitarian solidarity and 0.7% public institution resources for cooperation (not expressly GNI).
Complete animal section reread. Original visually confirms redirija. General opposition to bullfighting does not specify its public financing; all other animal questions stay unscored.

La Palma annex introduction: safer resettlement/planning, farm consolidation/ecological model, economic uses on lava except areas with high scientific/environmental interest; neither protect all lava nor unlimited development.

La Palma annex: State 100-million annual reconstruction aid next legislature, agroindustry/infrastructure/tourism and interadministrative/affected-person consortium; 50% worker/company social-security rebate with limits/conditions to define, not national income-tax cut.
Back cover website only, no additional annex.
